title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat in the Queues app Recap tab for recorded call queue calls
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing statements, recording prerequisites and control paths are supported. Microsoft documents Copilot for recorded queue calls, while the briefing appropriately distinguishes the surrounding calling-policy control from a confirmed control over this Recap option.

claims.quote: This article is for IT pros and Teams administrators who want to configure automatic recording and transcription for inbound call queue calls.

claims.quote: When enabled, all inbound call queue calls are automatically recorded when a representative (agent) answers.

claims.claim: The automatic recording template determines which recordings representatives can access.
claims.quote: Select which call recordings call queue representatives (agents) can access.

claims.claim: The representative-access setting cannot be changed after template creation.
claims.quote: Select which call recordings call queue representatives (agents) can access. Authorized users have access by default. ... This setting can't be modified once the template is created.

claims.claim: A Teams administrator assigning a recording template must also be a SharePoint site administrator for its site.
claims.quote: To assign an automatic recording template to a call queue or manage its authorized users list, the Teams administrator must also be a SharePoint site administrator for the site used by the template.

claims.claim: A Teams administrator managing authorised users for a queue with the template must also be a SharePoint site administrator for its site.
claims.quote: To assign an automatic recording template to a call queue or manage its authorized users list, the Teams administrator must also be a SharePoint site administrator for the site used by the template.

claims.claim: The Teams administrator creating the template becomes administrator of the associated SharePoint site.
claims.quote: The Teams administrator creating the automatic recording template becomes the SharePoint site admin of the template's associated site.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Voice > Templates and resources > Templates > Automatic Recording > Add > Call recording reaches the recording setting on the template creation page.
claims.quote: go to Voice > Templates and resources. ... Select Templates. ... Select Automatic Recording as the template type. ... Select Add ... Call recording is enabled by default. Disable call recording if required.

claims.claim: New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate -RecordingEnabled $true -TranscriptionEnabled $true -AgentViewPermission <None or All> creates a template with those settings in MicrosoftTeams PowerShell.
claims.quote: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module ... [-TranscriptionEnabled <Boolean>] [-RecordingEnabled <Boolean>] [-AgentViewPermission <Object>] ... Are agents allowed to access the recordings or transcriptions. Supported values: None | All

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Voice > Calling policies > policy > Copilot reaches the calling-policy Copilot setting.
claims.quote: Expand Voice from the navigation pane. ... select Calling policies. ... Either select an existing policy or create a new one. ... From the dropdown for the Copilot setting, select On, On with saved transcript required, or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Disabled turns off Copilot for calls under that policy.
claims.quote: To turn off Copilot for calls, use the following command: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Disabled
